title: Barriers to and facilitators of general dentists performing intraoral biopsies
html: Early detection of oral potentially malignant disorders and oral cancer relies heavily on biopsy for definitive diagnosis. Yet biopsies remain underused in general dentist practices. To better understand these practice behaviors, the authors examined whether general dentists perform intraoral biopsies and what they perceived to be barriers to and facilitators of their biopsy-related behaviors in practice.
